activation_rules.when: access is no longer LIBRARY when a B/C item is activated (viewer re-hosted, secure review)
activation_rules.outcome: menu closes; no action, no dialog, nothing written

activation_rules.when: current item changed since the menu opened (swipe, deletion, refresh)
activation_rules.outcome: menu closes; no action; never acts on the new or a neighbouring item

activation_rules.when: Set as wallpaper: URI unreadable or grant revoked before the handoff
Set as wallpaper: no activity resolves ACTION_ATTACH_DATA
Copy image: URI unreadable or grant revoked before ClipData is set (clipboard not touched)
activation_rules.outcome: C-revoked dialog; the clipboard was not changed (known: no write was attempted)

activation_rules.when: Copy image: clipboard service failed or the commit state is unknown after the write call
activation_rules.outcome: C-unconfirmed dialog; no claim about the clipboard; prior clipboard content is never read or restored; no automatic retry
fail closed: no fallback photo (no cached bitmap, thumbnail or other item is used instead)
